"'''Freak Me'''" is a song by American R&B group [[Silk (group)|Silk]]. It was released in February 1993 as the second single from their debut album, ''[[Lose Control (album)|Lose Control]]'' (1992). It was co-written and co-produced by [[Keith Sweat]], for whom Silk was a touring opening act. Tim Cameron, Jimmy Gates and [[Gary Jenkins|Gary "Lil G" Jenkins]] sing lead on the song.

"Freak Me" is a song by American R&B group Silk. It was released in February 1993 as the second single from their debut album, Lose Control (1992). It was co-written and co-produced by Keith Sweat, for whom Silk was a touring opening act. Tim Cameron, Jimmy Gates and Gary "Lil G" Jenkins sing lead on the song.

sections.heading: Commercial performance
sections.wikitext:
The song was the group's highest-charting hit single, reaching number-one on the [[Billboard Hot 100|''Billboard'' Hot 100]] for two weeks, and also spending ten weeks at number two. It also topped the ''Billboard'' [[Hot R&B/Hip-Hop Songs|Hot R&B Singles]] chart for eight weeks. It was certified [[RIAA certification|platinum]] by the [[Recording Industry Association of America]] (RIAA) and sold over 1.3 million copies domestically.<ref>{{cite certification |region=United States |artist=Silk |title=Freak Me |access-date=May 4, 2015}}</ref><ref>{{cite magazine |url=https://books.google.com/books?id=FwgEAAAAMBAJ&pg=PA73 |title=Best-Selling Records of 1993 |magazine=[[Billboard (magazine)|Billboard]]|publisher=BPI Communications|date=January 15, 1994 |access-date=May 4, 2015 |page=73 |issn=0006-2510|volume=106|number=3}}</ref>

The song was covered by [[Another Level (group)|Another Level]], and their version reached No. 1 on the UK chart.
sections.text:
The song was the group's highest-charting hit single, reaching number-one on the Billboard Hot 100 for two weeks, and also spending ten weeks at number two. It also topped the Billboard Hot R&B Singles chart for eight weeks. It was certified platinum by the Recording Industry Association of America (RIAA) and sold over 1.3 million copies domestically.

The song was covered by Another Level, and their version reached No. 1 on the UK chart.

The song was [[cover version|covered]] by British [[boy band]] [[Another Level (group)|Another Level]] in 1998. It was released on 6 July 1998 as the second single from the [[Another Level (Another Level album)|band's self-titled debut album]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Freak Me [CD 1]: Another Level: Amazon.co.uk: Music|url=https://www.amazon.co.uk/dp/B00000B96R|publisher=[[Amazon.com|Amazon.co.uk]]}}</ref> This version reached number one on the [[UK Singles Chart]], overtaking [[Billie Piper|Billie]]'s "[[Because We Want To]]".<ref name="British Hit Singles & Albums">{{cite book
| first= David
| last= Roberts
| year= 2006
| title= [[British Hit Singles & Albums]]
| edition= 19th
| publisher= Guinness World Records Limited 
| location= London
| isbn= 1-904994-10-5
| page= 4622}}</ref> It was produced by Fitzgerald Scott, [[Cutfather]] and Joe; it was the seventeenth biggest-selling boy band single of the 1990s in the UK, selling over 415,000 copies.

The song was covered by British boy band Another Level in 1998. It was released on 6 July 1998 as the second single from the band's self-titled debut album. This version reached number one on the UK Singles Chart, overtaking Billie's "Because We Want To". It was produced by Fitzgerald Scott, Cutfather and Joe; it was the seventeenth biggest-selling boy band single of the 1990s in the UK, selling over 415,000 copies.
